body.objective: Students will be able to organize a presentation.
successCriteria: I can organize a formal presentation with an introduction, body and conclusion
I can use signposting words and formal expressions
I can answer audience questions politely
body.hook: A good presentation in any language has a clear map: tell them what you'll say, say it, then tell them what you said. Mandarin has its own signpost words, 首先 shǒuxiān, 其次 qícì, 最后 zuìhòu, 总之 zǒngzhī, that make your talk easy to follow.

study.title: 我的演讲 Wǒ de yǎnjiǎng
study.question: How do I deliver a clear, formal presentation in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Structure:
1. Opening: 大家好！Dàjiā hǎo! 今天我想跟大家谈谈… Jīntiān wǒ xiǎng gēn dàjiā tántan... (Today I'd like to talk with everyone about...). 我的演讲有三个部分。Wǒ de yǎnjiǎng yǒu sān ge bùfen.
2. Body: 首先… shǒuxiān (first), 其次… qícì (next), 另外… lìngwài (in addition), 最后… zuìhòu (finally). Give examples: 比如… bǐrú (for example).
3. Conclusion: 总之… zǒngzhī (in summary), 我的观点是… wǒ de guāndiǎn shì (my view is). 谢谢大家！
4. Questions: 大家有什么问题吗？Dàjiā yǒu shénme wèntí ma? Answering: 这是个好问题。Zhè shì ge hǎo wèntí. 我不太确定，但是我认为… Wǒ bú tài quèdìng, dànshì wǒ rènwéi...
Model opening: 大家好！今天我想跟大家谈谈学习中文的好处。首先，中文是世界上说的人最多的语言之一。其次，学中文可以帮助我们了解中国文化。最后，会说中文对以后找工作很有帮助。总之，我认为学中文非常值得。谢谢大家！
Delivery tips: make eye contact, speak slowly and clearly, use tones carefully, use a few key words on cards, not a full script.
Task: Prepare and deliver a three-minute presentation on a topic from this course.

examples.title: Opening
examples.problem: Begin a presentation about Chinese festivals.
examples.answer: 大家好！今天我想跟大家谈谈中国的节日。我的演讲有三个部分。

examples.title: Signposting
examples.problem: Order these: 最后, 首先, 其次.
examples.answer: 首先, 其次, 最后

examples.title: Conclusion
examples.answer: 总之，我认为科技让生活更方便，但是我们不能用得太多。谢谢大家！

examples.title: Question
examples.answer: 这是个好问题。我不太确定，但是我认为…
examples.explore: Why not just say 不知道?

practice.q: How do you say "Thank you, everyone"?

practice.a: 大家好！今天我想跟大家谈谈…

practice.q: What are the three reasons in the model?
practice.a: Many speakers, understanding culture, help finding jobs.

practice.q: Why use key-word cards instead of reading a script?
practice.a: You can make eye contact and sound natural.

practice.q: How should you answer a question you're unsure of?
practice.a: 这是个好问题。我不太确定，但是我认为…

practice.q: Why are tones especially important in a presentation?
practice.a: Wrong tones can change meaning and confuse listeners.

practice.q: Why tell the audience how many parts your talk has?
practice.a: It gives them a map to follow.

misconceptions: Reading a full script without eye contact
Using 然后 for every transition
Ending abruptly without a conclusion or thanks
exitTicket: Put 首先, 总之, 其次, 最后 in order.

items.q: Explain the structure of a formal presentation in Mandarin.
items.answer: Opening with topic and parts, body with signposts and examples, conclusion, thanks and questions.

items.answer: Eye contact, speak slowly, careful tones, key-word cards.
